Rail Trail: Royal Leamington Spa Circular via Offchurch
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 7.2-mile walk branching out from this fashionable spa town to follow the Grand Union Canal to the village of Offchurch and back via Newbold Comyn. Duration: 4 hours Distance: 7.2 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: The Avon Valley from Rugby Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3-mile walk sampling a different side of Rugby, with an amble along the Avon Valley through peace and quiet to the village of Clifton-upon-Dunsmore. Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 3 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Coventry Arena > Bedworth
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.5-mile amble along the Coventry Canal from a world class exhibition centre to the former mining town of Bedworth. Duration: 2 hours Distance: 3.5 miles

r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.5-mile pleasant short walk over fields to the Coventry Canal, then up to Marston Junction and returning to Bedworth via the Ashby Canal. Duration: 3 hours Distance: 6.3 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Bermuda Park > Bedworth
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.5-mile surprisingly rural walk between two stations on the Coventry to Nuneaton Line. Discover canals, countryside and a splash of mining heritage. Duration: 2 hours Distance: 3.5 miles
